title.narrative: Responding to urgent WASH and Protection needs for conflict-affected children

description.narrative: Under this contribution from CERF, and in line with the Interagency Flash Appeal strategic objectives, UNICEF will support critical life-saving WASH interventions to ensure accessible drinking water services as well as protection for conflict affected children. For WASH, critical lifesaving interventions include emergency fuel provision to ensure the continuation of drinking supply from the Water Establishments to sustain adequate drinking water supply in the areas hosting newly displaced populations and to meet the growing demand. Additionally, UNICEF will provide the necessary repair and maintenance support for existing WASH infrastructure in areas of high displacement, to ensure the continuity of safe drinking water and improved sanitation (mainly in the governorates of Bekaa, Beirut, Mount Lebanon, South and North). Additionally, emergency spare parts for the Water Establishment will also be procured which are essential to ensure life-saving water supply is not disrupted. Moreover, WASH facilities will be improved through procurement and installation of shower and latrines (including consideration of gender-specific needs and risks in the intervention), in addition to menstrual hygiene management (MHM) materials, in collective shelters in Beirut and Mount Lebanon.For child protection, through this CERF contribution, UNICEF will provide psychosocial support to children, as well as case management support including for separated and unaccompanied children and those affected by armed conflict. Psychosocial support/assistance will also be extended to caregivers as they are also profoundly affected by the repercussions of this conflict. UNICEF's overall support package seeks to create a safer environment for children and their caregivers in a very challenging and dangerous environment. Main locations of the intervention will be in North and Bekaa.
